notes: Early-duel tank-killer: Chomp and Subjugate steal AD/resistances and Pillar isolates targets. Excellent into tank-heavy comps and as a side-lane/skirmish threat; struggles vs ranged kiters (Vayne, Teemo, Quinn) and falls off vs scaled carries.

Crit split-pusher whose Undying Rage makes him unkillable for 5s; wins through 1-3-1 side pressure that forces two-man answers. Hard-countered by armor/attack-speed-slow tanks (Malphite), Nasus Wither and point-click CC; adds almost no teamfight utility.

Global pick mage: Destiny + Gold Card lets him collapse on side lanes and turn cross-map skirmishes, with strong waveclear to free his lane. Needs follow-up (Nocturne, Galio) and lane priority; loses 1v1 all-ins to Kassadin/Fizz/Yasuo and is blanked by spell shields.

Stealth scaling hypercarry: ambushes out of Camouflage and melts front-to-back fights with Spray and Pray's piercing range. Wants an enchanter (Lulu, Yuumi) and peel; weak early and to Windwall, Braum and hard dive.

Stance-swapping juggernaut with fast full clears, strong early duels and run-down ganks via Blazing Stampede's stun. Wants skirmishes and a front-to-back fight; kiting/ranged comps and scaled carries beat him.

Ranged juggernaut who wins extended fights with Purge and shotgun-knee passive, flips targets with Disdain and executes with Fear Beyond Death. Beats short-range melee bruisers (Darius, Aatrox); struggles vs armor-stacking tanks and ranged/kiting tops.

Long-range poke/lethality (or on-hit) marksman: Piercing Arrow sieges, Chain of Corruption starts picks and fights, Hail of Arrows applies Grievous Wounds. Pro staple for poke/pick comps (Karma, Jayce); weaker in hard all-in lanes and vs hyper-scalers late.

Tank-shredding hypercarry: Silver Bolts true damage and Tumble/Final Hour stealth make her a late-game 1v5 threat and a duelist top. Weak early lane, short range; needs peel/enchanters (Lulu, Janna) and falls to hard CC, burst and ranged bullies.

Infinitely scaling burst mage: stacks AP from farming and one-shots carries with Primordial Burst, while Event Horizon zones divers. Weak early and to mobile assassins (Katarina, LeBlanc); pairs with AoE engage that shoves enemies into the cage.

Artillery mage with the longest reliable poke and true-damage passive that also punishes tanks; Life Form Disintegration Ray shreds grouped teams. Immobile: needs frontline/disengage and loses to hooks (Blitzcrank) and assassins that reach him.

Anti-mobility burst mage: Gloom punishes dashes and Personal Space/Doom fear dive, making her a premier counter to Yasuo, Yone, LeBlanc and Akali. Good waveclear and R follow-up on picks; outranged by immobile artillery mages (Xerath, Hwei) and out-sustained by Vladimir.

Dive/pick jungler: Cease and Desist is an unstoppable point-and-click lockdown on the priority carry, great for starting fights and securing picks; strong gank pressure. Weaker into peel/kite comps and early duelists (Warwick, Zac).

Reset-based skirmisher: possessing kills chains fights and heals him, snowballing messy teamfights. Needs early leads and chaotic fights; struggles vs early duelists (Warwick), heavy chain-CC and disciplined front-to-back comps.

Scaling control mage: Hextech Ray waveclear/poke, Gravity Field zone-stun and Arcane Storm give strong teamfight zone once Hex Fragment augments come online; also flexes bot as a lane-bully mage. Immobile, so vulnerable to longer-range mages (Xerath) and assassins.

Self-sustaining AP scaler: Transfusion healing and Sanguine Pool make him hard to kill, and Hemoplague bursts grouped enemies late. Weak pre-6/early levels; hates Grievous Wounds, long-range control mages (Malzahar) and early lane bullies top.

Early-game dive juggernaut: Thundering Smash stun, Frenzied Maul healing and Stormbringer tower-disable let him dive backlines and towers. Snowballs early; weak to kiting/ranged tops (Teemo, Quinn) and scales poorly.

Drain-tank early ganker: Blood Hunt tracks low-HP targets and Infinite Duress suppresses a carry for follow-up; wins early duels and 2v2s with self-healing. Falls off late; hates Grievous Wounds, Rammus and kiting junglers.

Teamfight marksman with built-in anti-dive: Featherstorm's untargetability and Bladecaller's feather root punish divers and all-ins (Samira, Kai'Sa). Best with Rakan; outscaled by Jinx and poked out by long-range mages (Hwei, Lux).

Premier artillery mage: extreme-range poke and Rite of the Arcane siege objectives and whittle teams before fights. Immobile and squishy — needs frontline/disengage and lane priority; hard-punished by assassins (Fizz, Katarina, Kassadin) and engage supports.

Early skirmish diver: Audacious Charge engage, Three Talon Strike knockup and Crescent Guard (blocks ranged damage) win early fights and dives. Pro-favored ball-carrier for Orianna; falls off late and loses to strong early duelists (Udyr, Sylas).

Crit skirmisher with double crit chance, Wind Wall vs projectiles and Last Breath off any airborne effect. Draft knock-ups (Malphite, Yone, Wukong, Alistar); countered by point-click/anti-dash control (Vex, Lissandra, Taliyah) and early armor bullies.

Mixed-damage crit skirmisher: Spirit Cleave dashes/knockups and Fate Sealed give AoE engage, while Soul Unbound lets him dive and return. Hard to itemize against; countered by anti-dash control (Vex) and early duelists (Irelia, Olaf, Jax).

Side-lane siege engine: ghouls and the Maiden of the Mist shred towers and win 1v1s, forcing multiple defenders. Team should play 4v4 with waveclear/disengage; weak to AoE-clearing duelists (Yone, Gwen) and Shen's cross-map answers.

On-hit/crit scaling marksman with hybrid (magic on-hit) damage; Cultivation of Spirit splashes attacks into grouped enemies and Transcend upgrades her W laser and E into a dash. Weak to dive when R is down and to early lane bullies; wants peel/enchanters and front-to-back fights.

Attach-and-heal enchanter: untargetable while attached, providing heals, move speed and stats to a hypercarry. Weak lane presence and low CC; loses to engage supports (Alistar, Thresh) and Grievous Wounds; best on scaling on-hit carries.

Darkin drain-juggernaut who wins long fights: Determination stacks grant AD and eventually a revive, with heals on Q and R; Q-recast knockup and W pull give catch. Bullies level 1 and scales into an unkillable late-game frontline; weak to ranged/kiting tops (Teemo, Vayne, Quinn) that keep trades short.

Long-range engage tank: Elastic Slingshot starts fights from fog and over walls, with blob heals and a passive revive keeping him in the fight. Premier engage for AoE follow-up comps; weak to Grievous Wounds, kiting and early invade/duel junglers.

Shadow assassin: Death Mark one-shots isolated squishies and shadows give elusive side-lane pressure. Pick/split win condition; poor into tanky or armor-stacking comps (Malphite), Zhonya's and point-click lockdown.

Hyper-mobile scaling marksman: Spark Surge wall-hops and Lightning Crash move speed let her kite and chain fights. Needs enchanter support (Lulu, Yuumi) and farm; weak early lane vs bullies and to hard CC.

Siege artillery mage: Satchel Charge/Hexplosive bombs demolish towers and waves, and Mega Inferno Bomb pokes from across the map. Wins by taking objectives early; needs frontline/disengage and is punished by assassins and hard dive.

Utility mage: double-bomb AoE stun, Time Warp speed/slow and Chronoshift revive make him a flexible disengage/peel and chase support. Chronoshift blanks assassin burst on the carry; scales with levels and wants a hypercarry to protect.

Long-range burst/pick mage: Sleepy Trouble Bubble into Paddle Star one-shots squishies and wins sieges through fog. High skill ceiling; weak to divers/assassins and Malzahar/Annie in lane, and to tanky comps she can't burst.

Plant-mage zone controller: Grasping Roots and plants poke and punish melee, and Stranglethorns is a strong AoE knockup/zone in teamfights; also a fast-clearing ganky jungler. Immobile; vulnerable to hooks and hard engage.
